## Skills & Tools
- Verilog
- ModelSim
- Cadence Academic Tools
- Linux Workflows
- ICC & STA Basics

- Physical Design Flow Exploration: Academic tool-based study of timing and layout concepts.

## About Me
I am passionate about semiconductor design and eager to apply my academic and internship experience to real-world challenges. I am continuously learning and adapting to new tools and methodologies in the VLSI domain.

Feel free to explore my projects and connect with me for collaboration or opportunities.
